graph.title: Emma's Splash Pool

edges.method: bar pushed down into open stud of round brick
flower stud pressed into goblet rim
dish centre pushed onto top of bar
two corner plates placed side by side, held by parts above
corner plate placed beside floor plate, held by parts above
corner plate placed beside floor plate, held by parts above

notes: The three separate groups are intentional and correct: the booklet builds three independent models: (1) the plant pot on page 3, (2) the sun lounger with bar, umbrella dish and drink on pages 4-8, and (3) the splash pool with steps on pages 9-12. Page 13 shows them as separate models side by side, and no step joins one to another. I have kept them unconnected.
Minifigure parts (hair, head, torso, legs) are on page 2 and in the booklet inventory but not in the given parts list, so they are not recorded.
Plant pot: lime round brick, reddish-brown axle plate, bamboo leaves, orange flower (steps 1-3).

Lounger: the 2x4 plate carries the pink brick and the end of the 2x6 plate; the exact overlap is an assumption from the drawings. Lime 1x1 round plates are the legs under the 2x6 plate. The bar and white round brick sit on the pink brick; goblet, flower and pink round plate sit on the pink brick; the umbrella dish sits on the bar.

Pool: the four pink corner plates are interlocked side by side with no plate-on-plate stack in the drawings; they are held by parts above them (recorded in other_joins). Step stack: white 2x2 plate, a second white 2x2 on it, white 1x2 on that, with lime tiles on each level (assumed).
Part counts match the parts list: 39 pieces.
